name: The Rain Rehearsal
prompt: Stage a tiny kitchen under a sweeping comb of brass watering cans. Stagehands on a counterweighted walkway tip only the cans over one actor. Each missed drop rings a different enamel pan in the orchestra pit.

name: The Theatre on a Spool
prompt: Mount a continuous ribbon of painted scenery between two gigantic horizontal spools. Actors enter through cut-out windows as a fishing village unwinds into a forest. A small audience follows the moving scene on rolling benches.

name: The Foldaway Audience
prompt: Set up a colossal green paper fan lying partly open. Its pleats contain rows of audience benches, and performers play on the narrow ivory sticks. A crank operator changes the distance between scenes by opening the fan.

name: Wings Awaiting Bodies
prompt: Lay two huge moth wings flat on articulated brass spars. Actors slip into velvet harnesses and lift the wings into a tent of patterned silk. Below the raised wing expose the treadles and stagehands that make its veins tremble.

name: A Stage in the Teeth
prompt: Fit little domestic sets into the missing teeth of two broad interlocking wooden gears. As the gears turn slowly, an actor crosses directly from a pantry into a ballroom. Spectators stand on the stationary central hubs.
